snippet.description:
There’s more than one way for Democrats to connect with voters. 

Sarah Longwell joins Vox’s Astead Herndon to explain what Jon Ossoff, Pete Buttigieg, Zohran Mamdani, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez are getting right — and why different politics and styles can still deliver a compelling message. 

Watch the full video here on YouTube.
